description: This file defines the 'FilterPresetStore' class, which manages persistent storage of filter presets for a shopping app using Android's SharedPreferences. It includes methods for retrieving, inserting, updating, deleting, and clearing filter presets stored as JSON objects.

classes.name: FilterPresetStore
classes.description: A class to handle storage and retrieval of filter presets using Android's SharedPreferences. It allows getting all presets, adding or updating, deleting by name, and clearing all presets.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all stored filter presets as a list, handling JSON parsing and corrupt data gracefully.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new preset or updates an existing one based on the preset's name (case-insensitive).

methods.name: deleteByName
methods.description: Deletes a preset matching the given name (case-insensitive). Returns true if a preset was deleted.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all saved presets from storage.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Converts a list of presets to JSON and saves it into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: presetToJson
methods.description: Converts a FilterPreset object into a JSONObject for storage.

methods.name: presetFromJson
methods.description: Creates a FilterPreset object from a JSONObject, validating optional fields.
